summary: The make_vomiting helper is now ported and sets timed Vomiting from cursed-horn case 4. The first remaining mismatch is the missing whole timeout.c:vomiting_dialogue helper: C nh_timeout calls it before decrementing the timeout, and its unconditional exercise(A_CON,FALSE) produces the step-62 rn2(2) call before gethungry. JavaScript still records that dialogue as unported. The historical case title says confuses, but this initial horn effect starts vomiting.
